topics.title: The AlgoBlocks Workspace
topics.task: Welcome to AlgoBlocks! Your very first task is to write a program that prints a specific greeting message to the console. Output exactly: 'Hello, AlgoBlocks!'

topics.title: Core Blockly Components
topics.task: Read a single integer N from the console. If the number is even, print 'Even'. If the number is odd, print 'Odd'.

topics.title: The Complexity Analyzer
topics.task: Read a non-negative integer N from the console. Construct a loop that outputs the string 'Step' exactly N times on separate lines to demonstrate linear time execution.

topics.title: Memory Visualizer
topics.task: Read two space-separated words from the console. Swap their values in memory using a temporary variable, and print them out in reverse order, separated by a space.
